svg.title: Water treatment operator — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as water treatment operator, wearing coveralls and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A tall rounded water-filter vessel has three separated media layers and an outlet above one clean-water drop. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
